title: Kagamine Rin — A Bridge To Mend Your Bond〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: A Bridge To Mend Your Bond（4★）

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, so Hii lives across from your house.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah... Back when my illness wasn't this bad, we used to play at my house a lot.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: We'd also listen to you and Len's songs together, and Hii started to love you guys just like I do...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Ever since we started elementary school, she'd come to visit and sing your songs for me every day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Every day?! Wow...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah. I don't have any friends other than her, so it made me really happy...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: But she only came to see me every day because I lied.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So... What did you lie about?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I told her that my sickness gets better when I listen to her sing...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: At first, I just said that it felt much easier to breathe, or that I was able to finish all of my food, things like that...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: But then I started saying all kinds of other stuff, like telling her my test results were getting better, or that I might be able to go to school if I kept getting better...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I wanted to see her...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Mom and Dad would come every day...
But... I wanted to see her, too...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Now that she's in elementary school, she tells me about these new friends she's making...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: But... I'm scared that the kids at school are going to take her away...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, you ended up lying to her...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
But my illness hasn't gotten any better...
And now I'm going overseas to have the doctors there help me.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: They said once I go, I might not be able to come back until I get better...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: And Hii heard about it from her mom...

rows.Speaker: Hii
rows.Line: You said you feel better when I sing!

rows.Speaker: Hii
rows.Line: I wanted to go to school with you...!

rows.Speaker: Hii
rows.Line:
You're such a liar!
I... I'm never singing again!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And she really did stop coming...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I can really understand why he lied...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (To him, Hii is an irreplaceable friend.)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Hii really loves to sing...
But... She said she's never singing again!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: What do I do if she starts to hate singing because of me...?!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You'll have more trouble breathing if you start to cry, you know...?
It's okay... It's all right...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
*Sniffle*
I'm sorry, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, don't apologize. Thank you for telling me all this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You look like you're in pain...
How about you lie down in that bed over there?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Can you stand?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Um, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: What do you think I should do to make up with Hii...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
First, you have to apologize for lying.
Then, you should also tell her why you lied.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think you two will be able to make up if you tell her how precious a friend she is to you.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Do you think so...?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
But, I'm sick...
When we play together, all we can do is stay inside and play games or listen to music...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: If she plays with the kids at school, there'll be a lot more stuff she can...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you don't talk to Hii first, you won't know how she feels about that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, you need to tell her how much energy you got thanks to her singing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And... I also want you to ask her what she was thinking about when she was singing for you.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You got energy from her singing, right?
That means she put some really powerful feelings into it, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I'm pretty sure there's another reason she got angry, not only because you lied.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
There's so much I have to tell her...
And so much I have to ask her, too.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
But... I've never fought with a friend before...
How am I supposed to apologize?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... When I've had a fight with Len, the first thing I say is, “I'm sorry. Let's make up.”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Huh...? Is that enough?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm sure it will be!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think the most important thing is that you feel sorry and want to make up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you still worried?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Sorry, you're helping me so much...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's alright. When you have a fight with someone precious to you, it hurts a lot, and you feel sad and uneasy.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
If you want...
How about getting me to help you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Though, when I say “me”, I mean a Rin that you create.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Huh? A Rin that I...create?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. If you can't express it well through words, put your apology into song.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Your dad used to make songs with me, right?
So, you can ask him to teach you how.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
B-But I've never even used a computer before...
There's no way I can write a song...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Maybe not a whole song.
But you can write a phrase or a melody!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Try really putting your feelings into it.
How you're sorry, and you want to make up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll take those feelings and deliver them to Hii for you!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, it looks like it's time to wake up.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
What...?! W-Wait, Rin!
I...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehehe, don't worry, okay?
I'll always be watching over your feelings!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Go, go, go! Y-U-T-O!
You can do it, you can do it, Yuuuto!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Oh! My name...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe. I believe that you can do it!
I know you can, Yuto!
Hospital Room

rows.Speaker: Yuto
rows.Line: Ngh... Oh, Dad?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Good morning, Yuto. Mom and I came to stay the night here after we heard you had an episode.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Your eyes are pretty red...
Were you crying about what happened with Hii again?

rows.Speaker: Yuto
rows.Line:
Yeah... And then it got hard to breathe...
I cried a lot in my dreams, too...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I see... I'm sorry, this all happened because we didn't know anything when we told her mom about your transfer.

rows.Speaker: Yuto
rows.Line: No... It's my fault for lying...

First, you have to apologize for lying.
Then, you should also tell her why you lied.

rows.Speaker: Yuto
rows.Line:
Oh...
That's right... In that dream, I...

Try really putting your feelings into it.
How you're sorry, and you want to make up.
I'll take those feelings and deliver them to Hii for you!

rows.Speaker: Yuto
rows.Line:
...!
That's right, I have to...

rows.Speaker: Yuto
rows.Line:
Dad, I want to make a song!
Teach me how Rin works!
Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
His fragment of a feeling disappeared...
Was I able to give him a little push?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really, I'm only supposed to watch over the owner of the feelings, but... Since those two love me and Len so much, I couldn't just leave them be♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Plus, that SEKAI might have brought us together because it sensed his calls for help.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really hope he'll hang in there...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Actually, no. I know he'll do fine!
Alright, I'll cheer him on from here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Go, go, go!
